programme.desc: 跟隨科學家團隊在雨季過後重新走入美洲豹領地,進行一次具規模的搜索,以尋找菲琳娜,菲拉和巴達洛,因為他們的追蹤項圈已經丟失迎接一位生物學家加入團隊,在他的協助下,麗茲·戴利為美洲豹重新安裝追蹤項圈,並添置高科技設備以記錄更多數據

programme.title: 美洲豹日誌 #4
programme.desc: 經歷風暴,洪水和停電,莉茲和獸醫霍亞雷斯仍奮力為更多美洲豹戴上項圈,情勢相當緊張一起尋找巴達洛的下落,並嘗試在追蹤標籤掉落之前找到他,以及拜訪一隻團隊渴望研究的新䧳豹

programme.title: 美洲豹日誌 #5
programme.desc: 見證奧瑪法瑞團隊為新認識的䧳豹阿羅艾拉戴上項圈,並一瞥她的豹寶寶阿波羅繼續追查巴達洛的落下,他似乎已深入森林;他的失蹤可能讓莉茲的突破性研究毀於一旦!

programme.title: 征戰火焰山 #1
programme.desc: 埃塞俄比亞的達納基勒窪地不僅是地球上最不適合居住的地方之一,而且是地質活動最活躍的地區之一火山學家湯菲佛正帶著一群冒險的遊客穿過達納基勒去看爾塔阿雷火山

programme.title: 超獸 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​沉浸在動物王國中最強大生物的驚人力量之中與銀背大猩猩一起衝破堅硬的白蟻丘,觀察能夠壓碎凱門鱷頭骨的美洲豹,然後前往海洋目睹虎鯨成群獵食的情景

programme.title: 超獸 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與地球上最快的動物運動員一起加速觀看死亡加德蛇在瞬間出擊,與遊隼一起進行空中暗殺,與變色龍一起捕捉快速的食物,並面對在海雀俯衝獵物時的驚人G力

programme.title: 地球演化實錄 #3 英普
programme.desc: 從撒哈拉到荒野,於極端環境中學習動物如何適應急速變化的氣候並掙扎求存與黑猩猩一起在洞穴中避難,看看駱駝以特別技巧飲用鹽水,並傾聽斑胸草雀為蛋寶寶由唱的歌,了解歌聲如何讓幼雛變得細小

programme.title: 大貓小世界 #1 英普
programme.desc: 在戈莫提河迎接春天的來臨,豹媽媽費芙和獅媽媽莎芭正在教導她們的幼寶寶如何在危機四伏的野外求存,並讓他們遠離成年雄性的威脅看看獅王莫雷洛如何戰鬥,獵豹森娜蒂亞則試圖在戰場上證明自己的地位

programme.title: 大貓小世界 #2 英普
programme.desc: 緊貼莫雷洛獅群的行蹤;當冬季洪水到來時,他們因照顧幼獅而精疲力盡見證獵豹幼寶寶如何作出艱難的決定,並目擊豹媽媽塞菲麗在經歷一場可怕的遭遇後,如何在自己家族與幼寶寶之間作出抉擇

programme.title: 尚比亞野生故事 #6
programme.desc: 非洲是一個充滿獨特和非凡生物的大陸,牠們經歷數百萬年的進化所塑造非洲也是人類的發源地,在自我進化之旅中,我們也跟非洲大陸的動物同行,但智慧帶領我們走了一條完全不同的道路我們的好奇心使我們對周圍的世界充滿疑問,這些問題通過故事,神話和傳說得到了解答

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #10
programme.desc: 我們在本集探討動物為何及如何戰鬥,並揭示牠們天生不惜一切生存下來的方法

programme.title: 動物長青術 #1
programme.desc: 我們在本集認識一些動物長老,牠們幫我們瞭解與長壽相關的心理機制,以及長壽動物為其社區帶來的正面社會價值

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #3
programme.desc: 安斯利前往冰島雷克雅未克,發現一種真心刺激的傳統和現代美食他用大蒜牛油烹調經典的挪威龍蝦,還有醃三文魚和檸汁魚生,麥芽麵包和在間歇泉中焗製的蛋糕

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #4
programme.desc: 安斯利的街頭美食長徵於大阪落幕,他在當地發現了製作大阪燒的藝術,有點像用班㦸包裹的英國早餐,嘗試日本風的小食,並製作生蠔天婦羅和辣蝦烏冬

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #5
programme.desc: 安斯利前往義大利西西里島的巴勒摩,並用上即捕的吞拿魚在海灘上準備海鮮麵食他又品嚐了包括炸魷魚,釀沙甸魚和島上獨特香蒜醬的地道美食

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #6
programme.desc: 安斯利前往臺灣,發現它是世上最偉大的美食聖地之一他發現香燉魚和辣炒豬肉,並用大蒜和辣椒煮臺灣大蝦

programme.title: 進化中的素食者 2 #6
programme.desc: 文拿在日本的中心狼吞虎嚥著素壽司和拉麵他從新學習煮蕎麥麵,自製麻糬,並參加傳統茶道

programme.title: 美食足跡:南非 2 #1
programme.desc: 華倫在世界著名的克魯格國家公園及附近開展第二趟南非美食之行

programme.title: 美食足跡:南非 2 #2
programme.desc: 約翰尼斯堡是探索南非的門戶城市!華倫在本集沉迷於深受當地人和遊客喜愛的桑頓區及周邊和精彩的國際口味

programme.title: 美食足跡:南非 2 #3
programme.desc: 在你從未見過的南非狂野東北海岸,華倫會發現自己愛上那空蕩蕩的海灘,粗獷的開放汪洋和充滿野生河馬的水道

programme.title: 美食足跡:南非 2 #4
programme.desc: 華倫在本集體驗當地豐富的野生物種,他主要在追蹤和尋找難以捉摸並瀕臨絕種的非洲野狗

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #7
programme.desc: 安斯利發現馬德裡是個充滿秘密的城市首先這個沉迷美食的城市禁止街頭美食那麼當地人如何繞過這道禁令呢?

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #8
programme.desc: 安斯利來到摩洛哥,但他沒有去馬拉喀什或卡薩布蘭加,而是去了豐富多彩,混亂而夢幻的費茲雜亂無序的麥地那是世界遺產,也是通往另一個時代的門戶

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #9
programme.desc: 安斯利到訪檳島首都喬治敦,馬來西亞人發現這個沉迷美食的國家中最好的街頭食品

programme.desc: 安斯利在美食之旅的最後一站到訪問約旦的安曼,那是來自伊拉克,黎巴嫩,巴勒斯坦和敘利亞中東一族叫作家的交匯處

programme.desc: 在犀牛孤兒院需要耐性與忠誠,因為他們要撫養那些因偷獵而失去母親的年輕犀牛

programme.title: 犀牛孤兒院 #2
programme.desc: 兩頭最老的犀牛將重返大自然三頭犀牛的失蹤引起鬨動,而年輕的犀牛則逐漸康復和變得快樂

programme.title: 犀牛孤兒院 #3

programme.desc: Families call on some big-hearted but practical ‘Aunties’ to help them through the rocky terrain of modern life, from money woes to health problems and love life troublesReal people, real problems – there are times when families need nothing short of their own fairy godmother to help them through the rocky terrain of modern lifenFrom money woes to health problems, strife with the teenagers and love life troubles, AUNTY MOVES IN is a series that answers that call for help, in the form of the big-hearted Amiria Reriti and Ata Te Kanawa, real life aunties, who are also fully-qualified – with honours – from the University of Life

programme.title: Black Summer
programme.desc: Incredible footage from ordinary Australians captured the ferocity of the bushfires that raged across the country this summer These videos have been viewed tens of millions of times across the world, but who filmed them and how did their stories end? A team of reporters and producers fanned out across the country to track down the people who found themselves in the centre of the firestorms What emerges are incredible stories of survival, bravery and heartbreak

programme.title: Addicted to Sheep
programme.desc: In the uplands of North East England, Tom and Kay Hutchinson set out on a near impossible task: to breed the perfect Swaledale Sheep They toil through sun, hail, sleet and snow to rear their flock Life on the fells is by turns idyllic and tough Surrounded by an ever-changing and stunning landscape, the family battle against the weather, financial challenges and the bizarre propensity of sheep to suddenly drop dead

programme.title: Good old Czechs
programme.desc: During World War Two, Czechoslovakian airmen fought across the world Defending the Allied Power's skies, they even played an integral role in the Battle of Britain This is the story of two Czech men who served in Britain's RAF - yet on return to their home country, a hero's welcome merges into persecution, as the communist party seizes power A timeless and poignant recounting of young lives sacrificed in wartime

programme.title: Immersion

programme.title: Discover China

programme.title: Aunty Moves in
programme.desc: Families call on some big-hearted but practical ‘Aunties’ to help them through the rocky terrain of modern life, from money woes to health problems and love life troublesReal people, real problems – there are times when families need nothing short of their own fairy godmother to help them through the rocky terrain of modern lifenFrom money woes to health problems, strife with the teenagers and love life troubles, AUNTY MOVES IN is a series that answers that call for help, in the form of the big-hearted Amiria Reriti and Ata Te Kanawa, real life aunties, who are also fully-qualified – with honours – from the University of Life

programme.title: Serial Swindlers
programme.desc: Exposing the world’s most convincing, creative, and criminally-adept con-men, Serial Swindlers goes inside their minds While their crimes and exploits are a ready-made Hollywood script, their exploits have left a trail of heartache, poverty and destruction

programme.title: Saving the Amazon
programme.desc: The Amazon plays a vital part in regulating the planet’s temperature And yet, in the last year, forest destruction in the Brazilian Amazon soared by 85 per cent The combination of illegal logging and slash and burn agriculture is decimating the land With huge profits to be made, the Amazon is a dangerous place to ask questions Despite the threat, the Amazonian tribes want the world to hear their message

programme.title: Deep in the Heart
programme.desc: Deep In The Heart follows four patients, Lisa, Ted, Greg and Pat, as they deal with the emotional drama of major life-saving surgery It’s an emotional story familiar to families up and down the country: skilled surgeons can fix bodies, but it’s up to the patients to make sure it doesn’t all go wrong again All four face pressure from their families to come out of denial and face reality Can they turn their lives around and quit the habits of a lifetime?

programme.title: Man on the Bus
programme.desc: Psychologist and filmmaker Eve always thought there was something not quite right about her family After a decade of searching for the truth about her mother's roots as a Polish holocaust survivor, Eve makes a remarkable discovery about a chance encounter that changed her life forever A compelling tale of two defining human traits — endurance and frailty — and a metaphor for the 20th century’s most painful trauma

programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地

programme.title: 如果還有明天

programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地

programme.title: 如果還有明天
programme.desc: 今天,有很多人正面對著生命中突然而至的苦難與罪困,在天災、人禍、病困及罪咎中,有人因為痛苦不堪而選擇輕生,但亦都有人在掙扎過後,生命變得更有焦點,更清晰人生的方向。影音使團製作隊跨越中港台兩地,拍攝對象包括:台灣風災救災者、飽歷風霜的一代影星、蒙古車禍生還者、從死亡邊緣活過來的反派演員、與癌同行的歷

programme.title: 葛培理牧師特輯

programme.title: 聖地流動教室-以色列破謎之旅

programme.title: 權能時間

programme.title: 主日講壇-宣道會北角堂

programme.desc: 攝製隊走訪美國、英國、 瑞士、澳洲、土耳其、以色列、埃及、中國及亞洲等國家,訪尋學者專家多年來從大地發掘的寶藏及科研成果,當中包括高山上經歷大洪水形成的奇異化石;全球首卷手抄絲綢中文聖經;以色列鑄造挪亞方舟金幣場等。n一切一切的資料,讓觀眾在欣賞地球的創造同時,見證上帝的奇妙創作及精密設計,從心感受

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地

programme.title: 如果還有明天
programme.desc: 今天,有很多人正面對著生命中突然而至的苦難與罪困,在天災、人禍、病困及罪咎中,有人因為痛苦不堪而選擇輕生,但亦都有人在掙扎過後,生命變得更有焦點,更清晰人生的方向。影音使團製作隊跨越中港台兩地,拍攝對象包括:台灣風災救災者、飽歷風霜的一代影星、蒙古車禍生還者、從死亡邊緣活過來的反派演員、與癌同行的歷

programme.title: 世界生命之道:鄺保亮牧師
programme.desc: 鄺保亮牧師,與父親鄺健雄牧師一同於新加坡帶領9千多人的教會,承傳父親熱心佈道的精神,繼續以激勵人心的資訊,挑戰我們成為為主擺上的門徒!

細味文明粵英
programme.desc: 作為南半球的國家, 澳洲既是大島, 也是大陸, 海岸線延綿數千公里 我們沿著昆士蘭州東岸展開旅程, 它跟珊瑚海接壤 展示不同的天然美景、動物、建築及人類活動等等 此行可以全面體驗最地道澳洲生活

programme.title: 手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 馬對遊牧民族的生活同文化來說是不可或缺的。蒙古人更把馬放在他們的傳統樂器上，製成雙弦樂器馬頭琴馬頭琴獨特的旋律不旦可以觸動動物的心靈, 也喚醒了蒙古人的身份認同，讓傳統文化得以傳承。

programme.title: 世界獨特社區粵普
programme.desc: 丹麥自由城是獨立運作的社區。擁有自己的法律、旗幟和獨特的生活方式。孕育了一個自由、民主和博愛精神世界。印度黎明之城 3300名來自世界各地的居民, 放棄了私有財產，貢獻自己的能力，為整個社區提供服務。

programme.title: 胡說八道真情假期粵
programme.desc: 李施嬅的生活品味人人讚好，眾女隨她來到充滿田園風的歐陸茶座，一邊享用精美茶點，一邊互訴六年來的姊妹情。昔日結伴旅遊樂趣多多，五女大爆胡杏兒的旅行闊綽事件！一眾好姊妹希望姚子羚快有「嫁期」，特意在澳洲教堂預演婚禮，場面既感動又搞笑。朱古力甜品讓女士們又愛又恨，六姊妹到訪位於菲臘島的隱世朱古力工廠，多款造型精緻的朱古力呈現眼前，埋藏多時的少女心霎時爆發。

programme.title: 兩個小生去Camping粵
programme.desc: 周柏豪、袁偉豪(Ben)出海往吊鐘洲感受異地風情，再到媲美布吉的甕缸灣浮潛，近距接觸海洋生物。柏豪曾任救生員，潛水卻是第一次！他們上水後邊洗澡邊談相識經過，是誰仍會登入ICQ戶口？二人搭營、劈柴、開爐，準備迎接人生第一次Camping，重點是要夠型夠瀟灑！不過，柏豪為此行錯過跟愛妻每晚牽手八小時，真大犧牲！喝着咖啡聊天，Ben提起當年選港男原因，而柏豪2019年榮升爸爸，最煩惱竟是走進產房的衣著！

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 地球約七成表面被海洋、湖泊等覆蓋，更有數據指全球海洋的平均深度為3680米。雖然這蔚藍星體蘊藏豐富海洋資源，但人類似乎對探索深海世界缺乏興趣？谷主凱婷卻指出下潛需承受極高水壓、漆黑環境、極低溫度等，都是阻礙人類涉足深海的原因。位於西太平洋的馬里亞納海溝，是地球已知的最深海溝。凱婷細述專家下潛探索的故事，還會介紹生活於漆黑深海下的特別品種鯊魚、章魚，並嘗試歸納出生物得以在這絕地適應存活的共通點。

programme.title: 海馬牌呈獻：魔幻百變床褥粵
programme.desc: 來自選秀節目《魔音女團》的莊子璇、喬美莎、倪樂琳、宋宛穎、倪嘉雯、盧映彤等「星級」藝員參演的微短劇。故事描述Hilary(莊子璇)為了追尋唱跳夢，參加「超級新星」選拔；某天，她於偶然下發現「魔幻百變床褥」的神奇效果，毅然有所決定……

programme.title: 濠玩夏水禮粵
programme.desc: Bob、金剛召集另外兩隊人馬展開對壘。瘋狂擺尾計次數，黃美棋、黃婉恩等美人魚玩到虛脫。化身攀石鐵人，深近視的陸浩明爬第一格已失手，楊潮凱卻敏捷登頂。伴隨音樂鬥快除十件衫兼做動作，阮兒自訂複雜動作可謂捉蟲；傅嘉莉極速脫衣除埋自家服！團隊合作運水盤，變倒水大報仇，朱智賢、劉溫馨更被指佗衰家。接力飲汁過三關，某成員過三關都唔識玩？要抵抗水花攻擊企上浮墊，做慣瑜伽有着數？豬隊友實至名歸，有人受罰前竟爆喊！

programme.title: 香港婚後事粵
programme.desc: 眼見圈中好姊妹先後成為幸福人妻，單身的姚子羚坦言對愛情有憧憬，但不強求！談到現時愛情與婚姻狀況，慰玲、天宇不約而同以中午來形容；自瑤卻稱是子時？年齡、地域可會是愛情的界限？子羚曾在澳洲讀書，回想一段異地戀，也認為只能接受年輕五歲的異性。主持們邊決戰四方城，邊談對伴侶同公司的看法。諾懿另笑言於家中佈置零話語權，天宇則堅稱不許另一半碰其愛車。食糊可向拍檔提問，諾懿想知自瑤如何看待頒獎禮「黑面」傳聞……

programme.title: 香港婚後事粵
programme.desc: 緣分天注定，婚姻要經營！玄學家李丞責細說玄妙之處，箇中顯露愛情智慧。每段感情都是人生歷練，關鍵在於有所成長。所謂打者愛也，被太太罵其實值得開心？諾懿笑言太太很愛他……名利不及家人重要，丞丞師傅坦言信任太太管錢，也談及夫妻相距十多歲的看法。面相揭示感情關係，眉毛雜亂反映易花心。眼大較感情用事，眼細則理智，慰玲卻詫異自己非大眼之人？子溢、諾懿另會憶述不浪漫的求婚經歷，有人更自揭婚宴當日醉到丟失婚戒？

programme.title: 智慧綠色未來：AI 賦能新時代粵
programme.desc: 人工智能如何推動綠色轉型？鄺潔楹、梁超怡走入「TVB綠色峰會2026」，探索AI如何賦能GreenTech及實踐ESG；並走訪本地大學及機械人公司，了解AI預測突發雷雨、協助防災，以及機械人節省資源的應用，剖析香港如何發揮科研、金融及國際市場優勢，推動GreenTech走向世界。

programme.title: 魔神創造傳粵日
programme.desc: 阿翔與麥格奉御羅院之命去阻止阿渡一行人，他們找來化妝高手模仿子假扮成瑪蘿，試圖奪走鈿女，卻想不到阿渡等人竟然接納假蘿瑪嘅存在，兩人見計劃失敗，唯有召喚魔神，與阿渡等人展開激戰。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 教練黃永輝再次亮相「WORKOUT 2GETHER」，首先引領現場眾人鍛練爆發力。除了做垂直跳、左右跳之外，做出波比跳時，他還設計了雙人猜拳互動玩法，小朋友在家也可跟家長邊玩耍邊做運動。另會利用橡筋帶與水樽輔助訓練平衡力，黃Sir稱相關動作對大家日常上落樓梯都有幫助，可減低意外受傷機會。「動物好萌友」則帶來大熊貓爬樹、吃竹子等日常生活片段。竹子是牠們的主要食物，每日攝取的熱量大約相等於20碗白飯。

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神秘怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧秘。

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神秘怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧秘。

programme.title: 安妮的童話粵日
programme.desc: 安妮當上老師一個月後，瑪麗拉帶回失去雙親的雙胞胎戴維與朵拉。活潑頑皮的戴維連番闖禍、說謊惹出風波，令安妮與瑪麗拉頭痛不已，但在兩人的包容與教導下，戴維終於明白誠實與被需要的意義。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
新聞透視粵
programme.desc: 香港有逾37萬名外傭，照顧本地家庭及提供家務支援，當中不少都要照顧小朋友。不過間中都有僱主投訴，懷疑外傭體罰小朋友，但即使報警也未能追究，當局在執法上有甚麼困難呢？除了懷疑虐兒，更多是涉嫌疏忽照顧導致兒童受傷，外傭一方如何看這些爭議呢？如何加強雙方保障呢？

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 香港國際機場2號客運大樓懸垂屏幕裝置鋼索突然斷裂呈半天吊，幸無人受傷。電動車車主早前透過中介以300萬購入啓德屋苑車位，竟發現沒有充電樁？到底哪方面出錯？成團僅三個月的魔音女團驚喜獲獎；出爐港姐馬不停蹄領獎之餘，不忘相約聚餐。有2次流產慘痛經驗的孕婦看中醫清熱氣惹滑胎驚魂！事主檢查藥方中竟有可致滑胎的天花粉，專家解疑。以亮麗攝影作品作自我包裝的自由工作者竟是騙徒？新近創業的苦主細訴中伏經過。

programme.title: 保誠保險呈獻：健康誠諾書粵
programme.desc: 雖然保養古董車要花大量金錢與時間，但只要是喜愛車輛的，就自然會不惜工本投入。親人的健康也一樣，陳展鵬的媽媽於2016年親身見證他得獎，翌年突然肺部現問題而病重，展鵬頓時覺得世界塌下。另邊廂，袁偉豪拍攝《鐵探》未夠兩天，卻收到爸爸因癌症復發離世的消息，正值事業衝刺期的他，直至拍畢該劇的休息期，心境才有「疲累」滲出！主持賴慰玲為兩人送上窩心禮物，提醒他們照顧者也需要別人於背後支持，有壓力就應找人幫忙。

programme.title: AlipayHK 呈獻：唱錢粵
programme.desc: 「復仇之夜」下半場，眾復仇者繼續輪流挑戰「落敗之歌」，能否「翻盤」贏得獎金入場券？Sing級唱將小肥、「爆機」素人Mani接力上陣打Monster，全力為復仇成功者博取更多獎金。另外，主持森美、李茵彤壓軸試唱，向《唱錢》系統挑機！觀眾只需用手機掃描螢幕上的QR Code，即可參與直播室互動，為挑戰者打氣，更有機會贏取福利。

programme.title: 伯樂音樂學院20週年呈獻：J Music粵
programme.desc: 黃寶欣近年共出三張翻唱專輯，這次到臨節目獻聲，揀選<憑著愛讓大家欣賞，還邀請劉錫明合唱<是緣是債是場夢。一場來到，錫明亦獨唱<無論再十年贈予觀眾。鍾柔美送上新歌<無名分狀態，提到是上首作品<不欠你一個朋友的續集。柯雨霏留守首爾，直擊Honey Punch的練舞狀況，更參與聲樂課「偷師」。許文軒倒數本星期「勁歌金榜」之餘，另相約Mike曾比特來場對談，Mike定下今年要多推出廣東歌的目標！

programme.title: 風味人間 第2季粵
programme.desc: 大蒜採收後容易變壞，甘肅農民遂製成蒜辮晾曬。金銀蒜是海鮮的絕佳搭配；當蒜經醋低溫醃製，又可轉化為風味獨特的臘八蒜。羅馬尼亞有廚師亦擅長以蒜入饌，煮湯、配多士都別具心得。魔芋內含毒素，經特別處理卻口感脆彈，與甜、鹹、酸、辣皆可完美融合。八月的湖北，有一種名為陽荷的食材出土，需及時採摘，方能鎖住爽嫩口感。薑是福建名菜薑母鴨的靈魂食材，經兩小時燜煮，鴨肉的鮮味，與薑的溫潤辛辣，交織出令食客鍾情的滋味。

programme.title: 香港賽馬會特約：J Sport粵
programme.desc: 孫佳逸、黃凱彤於全港乒乓球排名賽稱王封后，二人感受如何？凱彤也談及兼顧運動與學業的挑戰。港超球隊大埔的陣容經歷不少變動，也迎來新贊助商，陳肇鈞、謝家榮等球員暢談賽季目標；還有港超比拼精華。中國電單車製造商張雪訪港，細談對電單車的熱愛，及品牌對中國、海外賽車壇的改變。港隊為征戰匹克球世界盃誓師，羽球前名將陳念慈再披戰甲。名古屋亞運將揭幕，港隊舉行授旗儀式。另送上粉嶺高球精英賽戰報，以及港隊展覽消息。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
飛虎3壯志英雄#1粵PG
programme.desc: Ｏ記跟蹤沛國軍火商到演唱會進行交易，期間沛國流亡公主與同黨企圖搶奪懷疑裝有軍火的手提箱，並發生槍戰，Ｏ記要求飛虎隊支援；碰巧現場有阿軒等飛虎隊成員被脅持做人質，范Sir要求阿軒等人裡應外合，救出所有人質。

programme.title: 香港婚後事粵
programme.desc: 緣分天注定，婚姻要經營！玄學家李丞責細說玄妙之處，箇中顯露愛情智慧。每段感情都是人生歷練，關鍵在於有所成長。所謂打者愛也，被太太罵其實值得開心？諾懿笑言太太很愛他……名利不及家人重要，丞丞師傅坦言信任太太管錢，也談及夫妻相距十多歲的看法。面相揭示感情關係，眉毛雜亂反映易花心。眼大較感情用事，眼細則理智，慰玲卻詫異自己非大眼之人？子溢、諾懿另會憶述不浪漫的求婚經歷，有人更自揭婚宴當日醉到丟失婚戒？

programme.title: 手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 馬對遊牧民族的生活同文化來說是不可或缺的。蒙古人更把馬放在他們的傳統樂器上，製成雙弦樂器馬頭琴馬頭琴獨特的旋律不旦可以觸動動物的心靈, 也喚醒了蒙古人的身份認同，讓傳統文化得以傳承。

programme.title: 世界獨特社區粵普
programme.desc: 丹麥自由城是獨立運作的社區。擁有自己的法律、旗幟和獨特的生活方式。孕育了一個自由、民主和博愛精神世界。印度黎明之城 3300名來自世界各地的居民, 放棄了私有財產，貢獻自己的能力，為整個社區提供服務。

programme.title: 細味文明粵英
programme.desc: 作為南半球的國家, 澳洲既是大島, 也是大陸, 海岸線延綿數千公里 我們沿著昆士蘭州東岸展開旅程, 它跟珊瑚海接壤 展示不同的天然美景、動物、建築及人類活動等等 此行可以全面體驗最地道澳洲生活

programme.title: 瘋狂歷史補習社粵
programme.desc: 貂蟬的眼淚威力顛覆三國，她向黎芷珊大爆自己在三國時代有千千萬萬個「分身」！康熙遺詔上「康熙傳位十四子」與「康熙傳位于四子」之爭，令宮中謠言四起，「大鑊密探凌凌一」找到宮中知情人士大爆雍正登基的內幕！

programme.title: 瘋狂歷史補習社粵
programme.desc: 西施令吳王夫差神魂顛倒，最終助越王勾踐反敗為勝，她是怎樣從重口味的鄉下妹變成美麗的天后？慈禧太后曾九道上諭要徹查「楊乃武與小白菜」案，究竟一宗婆媳糾紛如何演變成奪命血案？CID兵分三路破解冤案真相！

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 農夫以故事形式介紹嘉賓JW王灝兒、梁釗峰、關楚耀與On仔（陳健安），Do姐可會收貨？曼谷的女化妝師擅長甚麼妝容？揭曉答案時還加映胡慧冲特別演出！來到「試食題」，名廚巧製「有營芝士餅」，究竟加入甚麼食材？楚耀和On仔藉「大大貼士」成功搶分，提示有多明顯？東京的監獄病院餐廳內，疑似肝臟的食品用甚麼製成？兌換環節，釗峰竟稱四個地方「各有鞦韆」；隊友JW更公開二人「親密聯繫」，引來連環笑聲！

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 農夫發揮創意介紹今集嘉賓陳山聰、陳敏之，總算得到Do姐的「OK」評級。「問題專員」陳雅思拜訪「濟州石敢當」，傳說觸摸石像某部位可保健康？巴黎一部「特大自助洗衣機」原來另有玄機！Do姐說出「洗衣機沒有電子裝置」的沒用貼士，對兩隊可有啟發？台北的「一人餐廳」在餐桌上放着一款牙醫工具，卻並非放進口中，究竟得物何所用？山聰與敏之帶着相同積分進入兌換獎金環節，但最終出現天堂與地獄的結果！

programme.title: 文明啟航粵英
programme.desc: Bettany繼續她的旅程,走訪烏茲別克、喬治亞、亞塞拜然、希臘、土耳其和保加利亞等地探索偏遠的社區,為觀眾帶來新的考古發掘以及意想不到的故事。

programme.title: 星夢頻道粵日
programme.desc: 由於還沒獲得星夢電子蛋，德薇與瑠羽在樂園四出搜尋，希望找到被丟棄的星夢電子蛋，卻遇上被露露娜追趕的Bug Bug CHU，還跟他成為了好友。露露娜稱Bug Bug CHU相當危險，德薇與瑠羽卻不以為然，一場追逐戰因而展開。

programme.title: 喜羊羊與灰太狼之羊羊趣冒險2粵普
喜羊羊與灰太狼之羊羊趣冒險2粵普
多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 大雄頭頭碰著黑，多啦A夢借他「轉運針」，可以令運氣恢復平衡。爸爸借了「令人討厭錢的糖」，大雄借了「令人想派錢的糖」，千方百計想互相餵食。胖虎搶走了「元旦日出套裝」，結果自討苦吃。

programme.title: LET'S CAMP! 露營少女粵日
programme.desc: 野外同好會需要大量劈柴，撫子正好借機會聽千明與葵覆述她們和惠那去山梨北露營發生的種種。前往營地之前，三人先在水垣湖尋找隱世美食，卻因此錯過巴士，為了泡溫泉，她們不惜徒步翻山越嶺。

programme.title: 嫁到這世界邊端粵
programme.desc: Judy、Dass帶陳貝兒參觀其位於曼谷市中心的安樂窩，貝兒從蝸居察覺到女方是話事人，男方則甘於被管，皆因他們深信「緣份」。身為佛教徒的貝兒，又怎樣看這二字？Judy認定遇到Dass是過世姐姐在天上安排，還因他改變急躁性格。兩口子坦言彼此是「愛情抽獎」的幸運兒，為何Dass認定Judy抽中了大獎？Judy嫁到泰國沒有受到歧視，反而Dass不停被同鄉歧視，Judy看不過眼要為丈夫說幾句！

programme.title: 教煮爭霸粵
programme.desc: 砂煲煲仔飯充滿傳統風味，看過鼎爺傳授新砂煲的保養方法，再由俊彥炮製「窩蛋免治牛肉煲仔飯」。俊彥採用上盛免治和牛、牛肩胛肉製作肉餅，配上恰到好處的流心蛋，味道與口感令人期待！飯焦夠香口，看三姐運用普洱茶、花生等製作新派飯焦。煒哥則帶來「海鮮肉餅煲仔飯」，除用上瑤柱、蝦乾等惹味海味，亦自製金銀蒜醬襯托海蝦，並以帶子夾金華火腿，「大堆頭」用料令煲仔飯陣容鼎盛，但鼎爺卻認為做法浪費了某種食材的鮮味？

programme.title: 教煮爭霸粵
programme.desc: 過年之前，一於炮製兩道「年年有魚」應節佳餚！煒哥呈獻「魚羊鮮」，將桂花魚起肉，以魚骨連同鯽魚、羊頸骨、羊腩肉等煮湯，雙飛魚肉用湯焯熟，保留鮮甜。煒哥以薑、蔥、蒜等製作醬汁，配魚肉同吃加倍鮮味。俊彥揀選東星班炮製「意式瘋狂水煮魚」，以魚骨、月桂葉、紅蘿蔔等煲湯，加入沙白蜆熬出的鮮甜湯汁，配上番茄碎及番茄汁；將表皮煎至金黃的魚肉下湯中浸熟，份外嫩滑。兩道鮮美菜式令眾人吃不停！評分時間，有人竟然投兩票？

programme.title: 初入職場·中醫季粵普
programme.desc: 《初入職場·中醫季》深度聚焦中醫文化，攜手中醫專業人才及中醫助力團一起，通過"潮養生活"與"中醫歷練"，開啟一場年輕態的中醫文化科普之旅。

programme.title: Gi味俱全粵
programme.desc: Gigi姐為大家示範做五香雞，而當中最重要的訣竅就是用雞的重量去衡量所需要的五香粉和粗鹽分量。而Gigi姐這次選用了嘉美雞，因為她喜歡它有獨特的質感和雞香味。在醃製時，她還出動秘密用具，究竟會是什麼？

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 李佳芯經常帶觀眾「捐窿捐罅」搜羅各區美食情報，對於「搵食」極具心得。然而，她在烹調甜品方面又是否同樣到家？古嘉俊邀請她合作炮製一款「抹茶朱古力千層蛋糕」，口味「層」出不窮，製作過程更是趣味十足。

programme.title: 魔神創造傳粵日
programme.desc: 御富良院有感風神丸力量不足，打算鍛鍊他，但對方老是不出現，此時他們遇到肌肉微笑健兒，後者指出御富良院變強即風神丸變強，御富良院茅塞頓開，於是努力做健兒教的體操，誰知結果卻弄巧反拙。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 有家長為小孩子報讀很多興趣班，以發掘孩子潛能，主持表示原來AI也可幫忙？「My Little Show」，四位舞者前來表演森巴舞、十歲歌者演唱<Over The Rainbow，從她們表演時展現的投入度，都可看出大家對跳舞和唱歌的興趣與熱愛吧！小朋友盼望長大，而成年人總嚮往童年，結他導師帶來八十年代兒童節目《430穿梭機》的主題曲，頌唱<童年時光。此外，導師亦帶來關於考獲樂器演奏級的資訊。

programme.title: 屁屁偵探粵日
programme.desc: 改編自人氣繪本。各位小朋友快跟著無人不知的名偵探屁屁偵探全面出擊，透過細心觀察及推理，偵破各類案件吧！

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 因為突然有客人來訪，令媽媽無法帶小丸子去百貨公司參加某個活動。不甘心的小丸子，唯有提議姐姐一起出外遊玩。野口同學提及一本恐怖漫畫。小丸子因好奇而借了回家。由於不敢獨自看，於是邀請爺爺一起。

programme.title: 財經透視粵
programme.desc: 近年市民對生活用品的消費越趨審慎，超市市道也在持續調整，讓主打環球直採的「平價超市」廣受消費者青睞，並且在各區急速冒起。這類超市如何在香港的零售實體市場，站穩陣腳？不少銀行及保安公司都有提供保險箱租賃服務，市場需求有多大？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
星期日檔案粵
programme.desc: 由食環署和屋宇署組成的聯合辦事處，俗稱滲水辦，每年平均接獲逾四萬宗滲水個案，大部分滲水源頭來自上層單位，政府於今年七月中，亦推行調查私樓滲水的新程序，期望縮短調查時間。有居住在舊唐樓、受滲水困擾的業主放棄執修，冀等待重建處理問題；有新收樓的業主面對滲水問題卻求助無援；有年過七旬的雙老長者及家中有孕婦的家庭，也正面對天花剝落等滲水危機，居民以為能夠得到一個安樂窩，受滲水困擾可以如何處理？

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 中信銀行(國際)Motion$呈獻：試真D唷粵
programme.desc: 江美儀繼續帶隊，這趟前赴台灣高雄「試真D唷」。自稱三十年歷史的燒肉老店，網上充斥「有甲甴」負評。美儀姐引領吳業坤、GM曾展望探店，點餐時已發現「小強兄弟」，「試真D」後卻發聲平反。坐在公園試吃平價巨型飯糰，坤哥、GM立即回店加購，究竟有多好吃？為歡迎張振朗加入，美儀姐帶他和坤哥到旗津食海鮮。團隊在觀光區發掘到良心店家，但也直擊到疑似專門「劏旅客」的食肆。要留意三人充滿腥味的真實食評，趕緊「避雷」！

programme.title: Funki Finance 呈獻：女神配對計劃2粵PG
programme.desc: 優質男士集結海選，希望通過主持Bob、嘉賓江美儀等考驗，入圍追求女神，首集來個花生搶先看！爆肌健身教練「公主抱」Bob做深蹲，驚變男男配對？街頭健身運動員展示「特別」動作，前女神關嘉敏、梁敏巧睇到嘩嘩聲。投行型男則以湯馬斯全旋，技驚四座！某男士隔空向心儀多年的女神真誠告白、有演員目標明確望續前緣，外向小鮮肉卻直言理想對象是樂小姐？首季表現「突出」的面試者回歸，水準依舊；海選還出現花生團熟悉的面孔？

programme.title: 一周星星粵PG
programme.desc: 緣分促成錢嘉樂、湯盈盈走在一起，盈盈2005年憑扮演醜角突圍而出，接受《東張》訪問時竟向路過的錢嘉樂問過一句「會唔會同我拍拖」？經典劇《封神榜》中，兩人是敵對關係，盈盈卻對拍攝已零記憶，只記得嘉樂在火車站的一次「身手展示」……好姊妹佘詩曼、姚樂怡、梁靖琪紛紛透過片段，盛讚「貪玩盈盈」結婚、生育後的改變；洪天明、洪金寶則大讚嘉樂於洪家班的本領。盈盈指一直期待嘉樂說出某「三個字」，能藉這次訪問如願嗎？

programme.title: Dear Leslie 70粵
programme.desc: 「哥哥」張國榮於《十大勁歌金曲頒獎典禮》成就非凡，不僅連續六年奪金曲獎，更曾榮獲「最受歡迎男歌星」和「金曲金獎」。除了重溫他的得獎時刻，樂迷亦可再次細聽<當年情、<有誰共鳴等「哥歌」，還有其傾注情感的<我。客串《香港'86》之餘，哥哥在《儂本多情》、《武林世家》的演出亦讓大眾着迷。哥哥於TVB的音樂特輯、MV片段，以及綜藝節目中的精彩表演亦會出土。他當年雌雄同體的前衛舞台，更是令人印象深刻。

programme.title: 美食新聞周報粵
programme.desc: 不嗜甜食的張與辰對灣仔一間「人氣」糖水店情有獨鍾，他與行仔品嚐芒果雙皮奶，更向老闆偷師炮製嫩滑燉奶的秘訣。黃嘉雯駕車載胡美貽到淺水灣開餐，享用炸魚塔可、手工西班牙油條配海鹽焦糖醬等輕食，享受悠閒時光。食評家Agnes推介主打避風塘風味的名人愛店，古法避風塘炒蟹及燒鴨湯河均為必吃招牌菜，滋味正宗。黃嘉雯再帶伍倩彤到錦田一間隱世餐廳，細味當歸豬膶豬骨湯米粉及煎肉餅飯等家常滋味，食材新鮮，令人回味無窮。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
飛虎3壯志英雄#2粵PG
programme.desc: 要放走很可能跟化武交易有密切關係的Pat先生，何家寶很不甘心。不斷努力找證據，但上級還是命她護送Pat先生去機場回國。途中遇到一幫匪徒企圖劫走Pat先生，與飛虎隊展開激烈駁火，匪徒事敗逃走。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 初入職場·中醫季粵普
programme.desc: 《初入職場·中醫季》深度聚焦中醫文化，攜手中醫專業人才及中醫助力團一起，通過"潮養生活"與"中醫歷練"，開啟一場年輕態的中醫文化科普之旅。

programme.title: Gi味俱全粵
programme.desc: Gigi姐為大家示範做五香雞，而當中最重要的訣竅就是用雞的重量去衡量所需要的五香粉和粗鹽分量。而Gigi姐這次選用了嘉美雞，因為她喜歡它有獨特的質感和雞香味。在醃製時，她還出動秘密用具，究竟會是什麼？

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 李佳芯經常帶觀眾「捐窿捐罅」搜羅各區美食情報，對於「搵食」極具心得。然而，她在烹調甜品方面又是否同樣到家？古嘉俊邀請她合作炮製一款「抹茶朱古力千層蛋糕」，口味「層」出不窮，製作過程更是趣味十足。

programme.title: 嫁到這世界邊端粵
programme.desc: Judy、Dass帶陳貝兒參觀其位於曼谷市中心的安樂窩，貝兒從蝸居察覺到女方是話事人，男方則甘於被管，皆因他們深信「緣份」。身為佛教徒的貝兒，又怎樣看這二字？Judy認定遇到Dass是過世姐姐在天上安排，還因他改變急躁性格。兩口子坦言彼此是「愛情抽獎」的幸運兒，為何Dass認定Judy抽中了大獎？Judy嫁到泰國沒有受到歧視，反而Dass不停被同鄉歧視，Judy看不過眼要為丈夫說幾句！

programme.title: 教煮爭霸粵
programme.desc: 砂煲煲仔飯充滿傳統風味，看過鼎爺傳授新砂煲的保養方法，再由俊彥炮製「窩蛋免治牛肉煲仔飯」。俊彥採用上盛免治和牛、牛肩胛肉製作肉餅，配上恰到好處的流心蛋，味道與口感令人期待！飯焦夠香口，看三姐運用普洱茶、花生等製作新派飯焦。煒哥則帶來「海鮮肉餅煲仔飯」，除用上瑤柱、蝦乾等惹味海味，亦自製金銀蒜醬襯托海蝦，並以帶子夾金華火腿，「大堆頭」用料令煲仔飯陣容鼎盛，但鼎爺卻認為做法浪費了某種食材的鮮味？

programme.title: 教煮爭霸粵
programme.desc: 過年之前，一於炮製兩道「年年有魚」應節佳餚！煒哥呈獻「魚羊鮮」，將桂花魚起肉，以魚骨連同鯽魚、羊頸骨、羊腩肉等煮湯，雙飛魚肉用湯焯熟，保留鮮甜。煒哥以薑、蔥、蒜等製作醬汁，配魚肉同吃加倍鮮味。俊彥揀選東星班炮製「意式瘋狂水煮魚」，以魚骨、月桂葉、紅蘿蔔等煲湯，加入沙白蜆熬出的鮮甜湯汁，配上番茄碎及番茄汁；將表皮煎至金黃的魚肉下湯中浸熟，份外嫩滑。兩道鮮美菜式令眾人吃不停！評分時間，有人竟然投兩票？

programme.title: 文明啟航粵英
programme.desc: Bettany繼續她的旅程,走訪烏茲別克、喬治亞、亞塞拜然、希臘、土耳其和保加利亞等地探索偏遠的社區,為觀眾帶來新的考古發掘以及意想不到的故事。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
高朋滿座#179粵
programme.desc: 自從溢跟母親到美國後，義每晚都要人陪他與溢視象會議。義被公司勒令放假，到按摩椅專門店消磨時間，但竟讓他發現，花亦被勒令放假，令義驚覺二人皆沒有知心友。朋命義為家中進行維修，義向花求救，花義無反顧答應。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#24粵普
programme.desc: 郭靖和黃蓉在白鵰的幫助下離開鐵掌山，為躲避追捕，又走進了瘴氣林。在瑛姑的指引下，二人找到段皇爺替黃蓉療傷，段皇爺服下黃蓉所贈的九花玉露丸以便恢復元氣，卻不料中毒；得知下毒的是瑛姑，便提及二人昔日恩怨…

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵 及 退休Chill級歎世界粵
食平3D粵
programme.desc: 今集造訪凍肉海產公司搜購超平凍肉，不用五元就買到一大隻鴨髀，炮製「鴨腿湯飯」至抵吃。「牛油、青口、天使麵」這個組合落入肥媽手上，24元就煮得好美味。還有肥媽推介、味道豐富的「醬燒巴西豬仔骨配焗薯」。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 長期鼻塞未必單純由感冒或鼻敏感引起，可能與鼻中隔彎曲有關？先天或後天因素都有機會引致此結構問題，耳鼻喉科醫生帶來治療資訊，還提醒長期依賴通鼻塞藥物，恐會陷入惡性循環。戲劇大師毛俊輝繼續細談在美國的演出經歷，開心獲業內知名導演賞識。回港發展後，他亦難忘抱病與黃霑、顧嘉煇攜手打造勵志音樂劇。此外，他感激太太胡美儀多年來不離不棄，也談及透過慈善基金，培育戲劇新一代。「睇餸食飯」，陳國賓示範「人參魚湯」。

programme.title: 今晚請客粵
programme.desc: 嘉賓王敏奕自懂得談戀愛起迷上下廚，還視之為傳遞愛的好方法。她近來喜歡鑽研素食，帶來一道既簡單又惹味的「韓式燒素牛肉」。杏鮑菇可變奏出不同滋味，諾懿大花心思，為美女獻上「杏鮑菇玫瑰」。揀選扇貝有何要訣？黑松露、金銀蒜看似味道不搭，兩者一同加入扇貝蒸煮，卻換來意想不到的驚喜！敏奕自製卡邦尼汁，奉上「蘑菇貓耳貝殼粉」；她又建議善用煮意粉水，可以有多種用途。另外，敏之亦會一展刀功，將士多啤梨變成美艷花朵。

programme.title: 天梯#10粵
programme.desc: 濟民要代苗天還債，更指賀正堂已無可救藥，無必要害苗天。濟民使計避開苗天，不讓他有請辭的機會。苗天未開口請辭，濟民已對苗天破口大罵，更打了他一拳，苗天承諾只幫賀正堂一年，最後濟民高聲嚷出要解僱苗天。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 聽到同學們說起善解人意的爸爸，再回家目睹自己爸爸宏志醉醺醺的樣子，令小丸子產生了比較心理，對爸爸滿肚牢騷。小丸子更嘗試透過改變稱謂，希望讓宏志變成理想中的好爸爸，但宏志卻依然故我……

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 非撞式欖球的主要特點在於禁止猛烈衝撞與擒抱，防守方只需以手輕觸進攻球員，對方就必須停下。非撞式欖球學校兩位代表到來「Kids’ Notes」，介紹這項運動的規則與玩法。由於非撞式欖球的身體接觸較少，適合男女一同參與；同來的女學員亦分享非撞式欖球的獨特吸引力。兩位代表淺談非撞式欖球的發展前景，更指出小朋友如參與這運動，不僅可鍛練體能，也能培養良好的堅毅精神與紀律。本集還有AI生成動畫《塞翁失馬》。

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 大雄用「重量燈」改變事物重量，先替媽媽解決體重煩惱，其後加重自己，成功把胖虎撞飛。大雄想借「傳染癦痣」轉移性格避過胖虎責罰，誰知在陰差陽錯下，令胖虎變得像野貓一般獸性大發。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 退休Chill級歎世界粵
programme.desc: 位處北都的洪水橋，樓價一直相對低水，政府早前於區內以片區形式賣地，能否刺激樓價？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
東張西望粵 及 海馬牌呈獻：魔幻百變床褥粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#21粵
programme.desc: 萬里需找舞伴出席為客人籌辦的慈善舞會，原屬意與文謙同行，卻遭他婉拒，遂考慮找安多勳作伴。朱圓圓卻大潑冷水，認為二人並不合襯，難有長遠發展。她更遞上一張卡片，提出可讓安多勳「彌補不足」的建議。面對舞伴人選，萬里始終猶豫不決。此時，安多勳一個奇異舉動，竟勾起萬里一段痛苦往事，並引發連串風波……安多勳意外得知萬里打算邀請他出席舞會，更偶然發現那張卡片，明白萬里的顧慮，遂決意成為「襯得起」她的舞伴……

programme.title: 死有對証#1粵PG
programme.desc: 清晨時分，流浪漢於垃圾站內發現疑似人肉屍塊。新任女法醫程芷昕第一天上班就奉命到場，搜索其餘的人體組織。芷昕自小患有強迫症，為人心直口快，在搜索過程中與重案組警員高俊結下不解之緣。芷昕想參與檢驗骸骨，卻被上司林琛投閒置散。法醫方文琪請客歡迎芷昕加入殮房團隊，從芷昕推薦的「佳權飯店」叫來外賣；林琛竟發現與案件有關的線索。同時，高俊也着手調查，線索皆指向佳權……芷昕閨密單佩嘉因吃過佳權的飯菜，大感不安。

programme.title: 百花殺#3粵普PG
programme.desc: 各皇子為取得西北軍權而想娶汐和，華雍便出手打擊。汐和得悉《胭脂錄》的幕後主使是康王，便誘使康王府的羅側妃頂證他。康王被捉拿後，對華雍透露當日餵他吃酪櫻桃的人就是下毒之人，而此人正是父皇，華雍不願相信…

programme.title: 玄戰粵PG
programme.desc: 自古以來，參透未來、扭轉乾坤的玄妙之術總是令人神往。然而，在流派百家爭鳴的當前，真正洞悉天機的能人，到底身在何方？注入直播元素的新節目《玄戰》，會掀開不一樣的戰幕。節目組廣邀潛藏民間的玄學高手化身「黑先知」，眾人務必通過重重嚴苛關卡，爭奪晉級資格。海選中表現最好五人獲賦以「白先知」身分，並與突圍而出的黑先知開展對壘。這是一場賭上名譽與實力的玄學之戰，究竟誰人可破譯天機、洞悉玄奧，成為「一代先知」？

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 退休Chill級歎世界粵
澳娛綜合呈獻：十月初五的月光#1粵PG
programme.desc: 歌女朱莎嬌年青時裙下之臣無數，卻不為所動。嬌妹莎華為人記仇，嫁得賭業鉅子萬世光，對舊情敵文貴芳仍懷恨在心。貴芳遭拋棄，莎華心涼。貴芳欲攜子文初尋死，不果，一走了之，遺下因受驚過度變成啞巴的文初由莎嬌撫養。莎嬌及後邂逅大學生祝展輝，為他誕下一女君好。展輝赴英升學，遺下母女。記者司徒禮信籌備澳門專輯，到賭場偷拍卻與君好發生誤會。文初得悉賭場中人對禮信不利，莎嬌、君好與禮信在一起，立即趕至救回眾人。

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋
programme.desc: 【狠心母拋家嫁富豪棄子重生只為揭穿母親真面目】一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火。年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬。她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世、母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與「繼孫女」的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具。母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言、親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決。

programme.title: 沒關係，是一家人
programme.desc: 【母親宣布「卒婚」引發家庭風暴父親失憶揭露大女兒身世秘密】故事圍繞著一對老年夫婦和他們的三名成年子女展開。母親突然宣佈要「卒婚」，因厭倦與脾氣火爆的父親同居，父親則因委屈一度想輕生，卻失敗導致失憶回到22歲，意外揭露大女兒並非親生的秘密。大女兒恩珠發現丈夫是同性戀，內心崩潰，而二女兒恩熙則陷入了複雜的感情糾葛中，被劈腿後又成了上司的情人。小兒子智宇無意中知曉了家族的深藏秘密。「像外人一樣的家人」間產生誤會，不斷磨合理解的家庭劇。

programme.title: 紙之月
programme.desc: 【完美善良主婦為小王盜用公款!尋找自由只是為了空虛的愛?】講述家庭主婦劉怡華（金瑞亨飾）在婚姻中得不到丈夫關心，日復一日過著枯燥乏味的生活，她開始復職到銀行上班後，想找回自身的價值。原本頗得客戶信賴，不過在一次意外挪用客戶的錢後，她從中嚐到自由的滋味，接著陷入無法自拔的漩渦中。《夏娃的醜聞》裕善將飾演她的閨蜜柳秋天、《邪門》徐令姬飾演想躋身上流社會的家庭主婦。此片改編自日本小說，其日本電視及電影版在日本得獎無數。

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落難千金嫁到三位「惡婆婆」家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！】該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪。

programme.title: 沒關係，是一家人(完)
programme.desc: 【母親宣布「卒婚」引發家庭風暴父親失憶揭露大女兒身世秘密】故事圍繞著一對老年夫婦和他們的三名成年子女展開。母親突然宣佈要「卒婚」，因厭倦與脾氣火爆的父親同居，父親則因委屈一度想輕生，卻失敗導致失憶回到22歲，意外揭露大女兒並非親生的秘密。大女兒恩珠發現丈夫是同性戀，內心崩潰，而二女兒恩熙則陷入了複雜的感情糾葛中，被劈腿後又成了上司的情人。小兒子智宇無意中知曉了家族的深藏秘密。「像外人一樣的家人」間產生誤會，不斷磨合理解的家庭劇。

programme.title: 紙之月
programme.desc: 【完美善良主婦為小王盜用公款!尋找自由只是為了空虛的愛?】講述家庭主婦劉怡華（金瑞亨飾）在婚姻中得不到丈夫關心，日復一日過著枯燥乏味的生活，她開始復職到銀行上班後，想找回自身的價值。原本頗得客戶信賴，不過在一次意外挪用客戶的錢後，她從中嚐到自由的滋味，接著陷入無法自拔的漩渦中。《夏娃的醜聞》裕善將飾演她的閨蜜柳秋天、《邪門》徐令姬飾演想躋身上流社會的家庭主婦。此片改編自日本小說，其日本電視及電影版在日本得獎無數。

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋
programme.desc: 【狠心母拋家嫁富豪棄子重生只為揭穿母親真面目】一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火。年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬。她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世、母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與「繼孫女」的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具。母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言、親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決。

programme.title: 被告人
programme.desc: 【話題冠軍韓劇，正義檢察官池晟孤軍奮戰尋找真凶！！】最強正義檢察官朴政宇，被冤枉殺害妻女入獄及事件發生後失去了記憶，成為了被告人。為了洗刷背負的嫌疑罪名而不得不在獄中拼湊記憶與找出殺害妻女的真凶，這時他也進入人生最糟糕的兩難選擇，陷入檢察官的鬥爭中。

programme.title: 另一種藍
programme.desc: 【宋茜邂逅周渝民，事業失意返鄉傳承青花瓷再現風華！！】北漂少女陳小滿努力工作、省吃儉用為求入股家族瓷器事業，卻以失敗收場，毅然決然回景德鎮專心學習瓷器工藝。陳小滿工作的上司柯巖則在投資上遭遇前所未有的失利，輾轉來到景德鎮。處於低潮的兩人在互相治癒中重新找回站起來的力量，事業重新起步，愛情也開始萌芽。

programme.title: 行動電源出發吧
programme.desc: 【不插電的戶外實境節目，重新找回心的連結！！】充滿冒險與成長的戶外實境節目，由侯彥西、陳妤帶領一群新人演員，拋開日常科技，踏上從「心」出發的旅程。山林間的挑戰、露營體驗等，讓成員彼此扶持坦誠交流，重新找回與人相處的真實感動。每一次困難互助，都化作心靈的充電，讓旅行不只是冒險，更是成長與情感的累積，他們成為彼此的「行動電源」，燃亮內心最真摯的力量與溫暖。

programme.title: Remember-兒子的戰爭
programme.desc: 【俞承豪為父申冤，朴敏英成為他正義路上的唯一靠山！！】徐振宇擁有過目不忘的記憶力，為了替被誣陷為殺人犯的父親申冤成為了律師，與權勢貪腐正面對抗。與堅守正義的檢察官李仁雅，從質疑到並肩作戰，成為振宇最堅強的後盾。就在逐步逼近真相時，卻發現自己正逐漸失去記憶。他們攜手在權力夾縫中拚搏，在時間與遺忘賽跑，只為守護真相與心中那份信念與愛。

programme.title: 水龍吟
programme.desc: 【羅雲熙尋找弒師真相的亡命追途，改寫江湖的命運！！】十年前，唐儷辭親眼目睹師門覆滅，卻被誣陷成弒師兇手，從天之驕子淪為人人喊打的罪人背負沉冤，只為查清那場血案背後真正的黑手。多年後，他帶著刻入骨血的信念重返江湖。為尋找真相，潛入暗勢力盤踞的「十三樓」，捲入武林與朝野交織的陰謀；與此同時，他結識池雲、鍾春髻等真心相伴之人，也在危機四伏的旅途中重新學會信任與牽掛。

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 【心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜為奪下豪門不擇手段！】人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象。出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼。而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友。當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨、正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始。

programme.title: 殘酷的實習生
programme.desc: 【羅美蘭化身高年級實習生道盡女性職場家庭壓力】曾叱吒職場的女強人高海羅，在為家庭中斷事業七年後，決心重返職場、找回自我價，從主管跌回實習生，她不僅要面對年齡與職場現實的殘酷挑戰，更得直面昔日競爭對手、如今成為上司的崔智媛。在一項充滿道德兩難的任務中，海羅被迫於同為母親的立場與職涯機會之間掙扎。劇情深刻刻畫中年女性在家庭、工作與自我之間的拉扯與重生，以真實而細膩的情感，引發無數職場女性共鳴。

programme.title: 當你沉睡時
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是只能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦。不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨。兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.title: 青春時代2
programme.desc: 【《2023韓國百想藝術大賞》得主朴恩斌共住女生宿舍，共度後青春時代！！】居住在ShareHouse的五位大學生，同住一個屋簷又過了一年，迎來了新的室友。臨近大學畢業的日子，求職與愛情的煩惱，五個追著自己期望的事物，繼續寫下屬於她們的青春故事。

programme.title: 少年時代
programme.desc: 【電影《原本以為只是手機掉了》任時完，大反派變小可憐少年，勇往直前成為校園新老大！！】出生忠清南道的瘦小懦弱高中生張秉泰，以「在學校不挨打」為最大目標。某天因父親意外的關係，連夜逃到隔壁村，轉學至扶餘農高竟搖身一變成為學校老大，親身體驗強者生存的熱血故事。

programme.title: 裝腔啟示錄
programme.desc: 初級律師唐影在上海紅圈律所工作，意外結識了合作方許子詮。雖然二人暗生情愫，卻始終沒有勇氣直面真實的情感。兩人歷經多次事件，最終在唐影的幫助下，許子詮驅散了多年陰影，敢於直面情感不再逃避，而唐影也在許子詮的信任和陪伴下，接受了自己最真實的一面。

programme.title: 青春時代2
programme.desc: 【《2023韓國百想藝術大賞》得主朴恩斌共住女生宿舍，共度後青春時代！！】居住在ShareHouse的五位大學生，同住一個屋簷又過了一年，迎來了新的室友。臨近大學畢業的日子，求職與愛情的煩惱，五個追著自己期望的事物，繼續寫下屬於她們的青春故事。

programme.title: 與君歌
programme.desc: 唐文宗末年，宦官擾亂朝政的時代，唐文宗與大臣企圖除去奸佞仇子梁，不幸失敗，造成宰相王訓被滿門抄斬，唯有兩個孫女逃過一劫，姐姐改名為煙織成為仇子梁義女，妹妹改名為程若魚/魚冰兒在紫衣局長大，新皇帝齊焱登基後，利用紫衣局對付仇子梁，也間接使得姐妹兩人針鋒相對，所幸最終程若魚與齊焱剿盪仇子梁成功，待齊焱逝世之後，由珖王李忱繼位，展現重振大唐的決心，勵精圖治。

programme.title: 少年時代
programme.desc: 【電影《原本以為只是手機掉了》任時完，大反派變小可憐少年，勇往直前成為校園新老大！！】出生忠清南道的瘦小懦弱高中生張秉泰，以「在學校不挨打」為最大目標。某天因父親意外的關係，連夜逃到隔壁村，轉學至扶餘農高竟搖身一變成為學校老大，親身體驗強者生存的熱血故事。

Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS – ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - El castillo de Robins
programme.desc: Como la lente no se puede recuperar, el Dr. No quiere fabricar otra, pero necesita petirrojos para ello. Así que ataca Rubidia, una región repleta de piedras preciosas. Pero Oxin, el rey de Rubidia, lo toma prisionero y lo encierra en el castillo donde también está Chip, ya que Oxin los obliga a trabajar como esclavos en sus minas. El Dr. No intenta convencer a Chip de que le devuelva la lente, pero Chip se niega. Más tarde, ambos logran escapar del castillo y el Dr. No persigue a Chip con su nave. Pero el chico atrapa al científico y también ayuda a liberar a los esclavos de Rubidia.

Los antimateriales están cerca y Chip le pide al músico que prepare la trampa para retenerlos y escapar. El músico acepta y los antimateriales se convierten en prisioneros, obligándolos a escuchar el terrible sonido de sus composiciones.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - Sabotaje
programme.desc: Chip es un niño de 9 años que prefiere jugar con sus compañeros antes de las clases de física y química con su maestra Susan. Un día, durante una visita escolar al Instituto de Alta Energía, un científico loco, el Dr. No, está realizando un experimento con una lente capaz de convertir materia en antimateria, lo que provoca un accidente y un rayo incontrolado que lanza a Chip y al científico a la dimensión del micromundo. Chip se da cuenta de que el accidente lo ha enviado a un lugar desconocido y no sabe cómo regresar. Unos átomos de hierro, mercurio e hidrógeno, representados como Fer, Merc e Hidro, lo guiarán para ayudarlo a encontrar el camino de vuelta. Al mismo tiempo, el Dr. No descubre que, debido al accidente, ha logrado crear antimateria, y el poder que esto le otorga lo prepara para convertirse en el amo del mundo.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - La corriente electrica
programme.desc: Fer, Merc e Hidro llevan a Chip a la Ciudad Atómica, donde hay noticias de otro humano, el Dr. No, que ha llegado al micromundo. Chip piensa que tal vez el Dr. No podría ayudarlo a regresar a su dimensión, y va a verlo para devolverle la lente que el científico perdió durante el viaje al micromundo. Pero el Dr. No está construyendo la Torre Negra, una poderosa máquina que lo ayudará a esclavizar a todos los átomos del micromundo. Ahora tiene muchos trabajando bajo sus órdenes, y los lanza contra Chip y sus amigos para convertirlos en prisioneros y arrebatarles la lente. Al escapar, Chip cae en una corriente eléctrica que lo transporta muy lejos.

programme.title: Andy's Global Adventures S01 - Andy and the Spotted Hyenas
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout jet off in the Explorer, embarking on a global adventure to Kenya in search of spotted hyenas. They discover how hyenas use a secret body language to communicate.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Why Badge
programme.desc: All the Squirrels are having a fine old time playing with the hose. All except one, poor Tag whose feet hurt. 'Why do my feet hurt?', he asks Duggee. While Duggee has a think, he tells them 'why' is a great question, and the Squirrels are quick to follow up.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Sibling Badge
programme.desc: It's news time at the Clubhouse, and the Squirrels share their exciting news of the week with each other. Happy got a new bath sponge, Norrie is growing a sunflower and Roly, after thinking hard if he's got any news at all, remembers he's getting a new brother or sister. The Squirrels have all sorts of questions to ask.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Monster Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are playing outside, when out of a bush jumps the cutest creature they ever did see. They think it is simply adorable and tell it so... with startling results. The creature bursts into tears! The creature, whose name is Plinky, tells them her whole family are monsters, and that's what she's supposed to be, but she just cannot get the hang of it. The Squirrels are keen to help Plinky get in touch with her scary side. Fortunately, Duggee has his monster badge.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Diary Badge
programme.desc: The day starts when Duggee moves a cupboard, and the Squirrels find a dusty, old book behind it. It's Duggee's diary from when he was a teenager! The Squirrels aren't sure what a diary is, so Duggee explains by reading some extracts. The Squirrels are keen to write diaries of their own.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Metal Detector Badge
programme.desc: It's a lovely day, so everyone is playing outside. Things take a turn when Roly needs a wee, because the door is locked and Duggee has mislaid the key. The Squirrels start looking around for it, but they have no luck. Not to worry, Duggee has his metal detector, Helen. After demonstrating it to the Squirrels, they are very keen to give it a go.

programme.desc: The Squirrels learn about butterflies and tortoises.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Perfect
programme.desc: For her Father's Day card, Bluey sets out to draw a picture of herself and her father together. While recalling her favourite memories of playing with Bandit, Bluey struggles with the idea that her drawing must be perfect. Chilli tries to convince Bluey that perfection isn't easy, or absolutely necessary.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Explorers

programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want to play restaurants with Grandad, but it's a little different than he's used to... he's going to need an app to order the food!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Pavlova
programme.desc: Mum won't let Bingo have Pavlova, so the kids find a way by playing a cheeky game of Café in the kitchen. But Dad the chef sets up a competing shop that only serves edamame beans.

programme.desc: Xuli's flying race around the Academy inspires cadet Tala to fly the Grimbler. But she crashes into a fragile sea arch that could collapse right on top of her! The Go Jetters must race to save her.

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Go Jetters Academy: Ghost Crabs
programme.desc: In order to help protect a sandcastle that he and Tala built, Glitch uses a giant vacuum to suck up the sand from the Academy's beach, exposing the illusive ghost crabs to the hungry seagulls up above. To make matters worse, Glitch and his Grimbots lose control of the vacuum, causing chaos in the ocean. Can the Go Jetters protect the crabs while also returning the sand to its proper place?

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Happy Happy Valentines
programme.desc: Mojo and Bo have to deliver a superfun singing valentine. But the problem is, they don't know who it's for, or who it's from. Preston is racing to beat them to it!

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - The Way of the Woods
programme.desc: A camping trip with Preston goes very wrong when he won't let them use Mojo's tops. But camping Preston's way soon starts a fire. It's Mojo and Bo to the rescue!

programme.title: Supertato S02 - Couch Potato
programme.desc: Evil Pea tries to trap Supertato down the back of a sofa but falls in too. Luckily, they meet Raisin, who lives there with her buttons and knows the only way out.

programme.title: Supertato S02 - Trolley Cruise
programme.desc: Supertato, Carrot and Broccoli get free tickets to go on a luxurious trolley cruise, but it's actually a one-way ticket out of the supermarket from Evil Pea!

programme.title: Supertato Songs S01 - Tatocar vs Evil Peamobile Song
programme.desc: The Tatoteam have the Tatocar and Evil Pea has the Evil Peamobile. But which one of these machines is best? Carrot and Evil Pea have a song to decide.

programme.title: Supertato Songs S01 - The Monstertato Song
programme.desc: Get your spooky veggie vibe on with this frightfully delightful Halloween track!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Dressing Up Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is wrapping a present because it is Enid's birthday. But the squirrels didn't get her anything! Maybe they could give her a surprise...but Enid doesn't like surprises. Norrie suggests dressing up, what a great idea!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Getting On Badge
programme.desc: When the squirrels upset the mole by being noisy, Duggee suggests ways that they can all live underground peacefully.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Wedding Badge
programme.desc: The squirrels are playing at the clubhouse when there is a knock at the door. Its delivery Chipmunk with a special delivery for Duggee and the squirrels. Duggee opens the envelope and takes out the card inside: It is with very great pleasure that I invite Duggee and the Squirrels to my Wedding... WOW, King Tiger has met his perfect partner and he is getting married. It's going to be a royal wedding!! The squirrels are to be special Guests of Honour, but who is King Tiger marrying!? The event qui

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Grandparents Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the squirrels are tidying up - its Bring your Grandparents to Squirrel Club Day. Duggee has his Grandparents badge so he knows what they will like, a nice cup of tea. But on arrival, these Grandparents seem more of a lively bunch than Duggee was expecting! Tag's Gran parachutes in from a plane and Norrie's Gran is a biker and arrives on her motorbike! Once in the clubhouse they launch into Show &amp;amp; Tell. These Grandparents have some GREAT stories to share!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Say Cheese
programme.desc: The Squirrels learn about butterflies and tortoises.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Eugene's Animal Chorus
programme.desc: Eugene gives an unexpected performance with help from some talented animals! Mooo!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Copy The King
programme.desc: The Squirrels play Copy the King!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Animals
programme.desc: The Squirrel club play games involving animals. The chickens do some rhythmic office work.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Mysterious Milkshake
programme.desc: More fun with Duggee, biscuits, eggs, toys and of course milkshakes.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Bingo
programme.desc: When Bluey has a playdate at Chloe's, Bingo must learn how to play by herself. But all the games she knows need more than one person! Luckily Dad has a problem that needs solving.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Rug Island
programme.desc: On Bingo and Bluey's Rug Island, a pack of felt pens can be anything: bananas, campfires, even a snake. But Dad will need to embrace his inner kid if he wants to make it his home.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Charades
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want everyone to play charades, but Muffin and Socks are too young to understand the rules and Nana must think quickly to keep the game on track.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Sticky Gecko
programme.desc: Mum must get Bluey and Bingo out the door in time for a playdate, but they can't leave before they finish their game - waiting for a sticky rubber gecko to drop from the ceiling.

programme.title: Bebefinn: The Big Animal World S01 - How the Red Kangaroo Stays Cool
programme.desc: Bora and Brody get Pio to show feverish Finn how a kangaroos in the Australian outback keep cool in the heat.

programme.title: Bebefinn: The Big Animal World S01 - Albatross, Bird that Rides the Wind
programme.desc: Everyone learns about the gliding bird that is the Albatross. It soars without flapping it's wings! But how?!

programme.title: Andy's Global Adventures S01 - Andy and the Spotted Hyenas
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout jet off in the Explorer, embarking on a global adventure to Kenya in search of spotted hyenas. They discover how hyenas use a secret body language to communicate.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Not Enough Room
programme.desc: The Teletubbies are about to go on the Tubby Custard Ride with the hat, bag, ball and scooter when they realise there is not enough room. The Noo-­Noo looks after their things.

programme.title: Yakka Dee S01 - Lion
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say lion and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see what lions look like and what they do! There's a big lion, a baby lion, a roaring lion and a handsome lion. There's a lion on a cupcake, a lion on a doorknocker and a lion playing hide and seek! A sleeping lion, a leaping lion and a lion that Dee loves! The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way and everyone has a boogie when Dee's friend finally succeeds in saying today's word!

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO S02 - Sparkly Messy
programme.desc: Preschool series. Messy and his friends discover an amazing cave on their quest for the perfect sculpture material for OKIDO's most famous artist, Zinnie.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - The Sticky Sauce Situation
programme.desc: Fabio's yummy new sauce is so sticky that he gets stuck to Mojo's bonnet. They have to do everything together until Bo figures out how to 'unsticky' that sauce!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Promises
programme.desc: Bluey keeps breaking her promises! But after seeing how much Bingo trusts Mum's word, Bluey learns the power of promises and why it's important not to break them.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Obstacle Course
programme.desc: Mum sets up a backyard obstacle course just for fun, but Dad wants to race! Now the kids are determined to win by any means necessary.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Cheerleading Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels find Duggee's cheerleader pompoms, so he shows them his old moves. Time to practice: Duggee at the chess board, the Squirrels as a squad. There's a big match ahead...

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Metal Detector Badge
programme.desc: It's a lovely day, so everyone is playing outside. Things take a turn when Roly needs a wee, because the door is locked and Duggee has mislaid the key. The Squirrels start looking around for it, but they have no luck. Not to worry, Duggee has his metal detector, Helen. After demonstrating it to the Squirrels, they are very keen to give it a go.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Cool, Man
programme.desc: At Squirrel Club, Detective Puppy solves the mystery of a missing biscuit, the Rabbits tell us what's cool, and the Squirrels help Delivery Chipmunk with a huge parcel.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - El Gran Final
programme.desc: Join the chickens in space for the big finale of Agony and Eggstacy! Mucho Suspense!

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Go Jet Academy: Hurricane Rescue
programme.desc: Grim HQ struggles through the sky above the Atlantic Ocean, fighting against the powerful winds of a hurricane. One Grimbot falls overboard before the ship crash-lands at Go Jet Academy. Needing another ship to rescue the missing Grimbot, Grandmaster Glitch steals Jetpad. The Go Jetters give chase in the Grimbler, heading right into the eye of the storm.

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Early Baby
programme.desc: Bluey's playgroup is at odds when Indy's baby hospital collides with Rusty's knights and dragons. But in explaining themselves, they both find that their games actually have a lot in common.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Duck Cake
programme.desc: Bluey wants to help Dad make Bingo's birthday cake, but first she must put away her toys. But nothing can tempt her to clean up, until Dad drops the cake.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Explorers
programme.desc: While waiting to be picked up from school, Jack plays at being a sailor trying to find his way back home to Australia. Meanwhile, Jack's Dad has got lost on route to collect him.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Phones
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want to play restaurants with Grandad, but it's a little different than he's used to... he's going to need an app to order the food!

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island S01 - Andy and the Baby Triceratops
programme.desc: Andy heads out on a mission to find a herd of triceratops so that he can place one of Jen's tracking devices on them. Along the way, he discovers a baby triceratops that needs his help.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Scarf
programme.desc: It's chilly, so Bella and Lift have fun with a snuggly scarf. In Boxtropolis, Sketch and the Playtimers make a no-snow snowman out of scrunchie socks and scarves.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Rainbow Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are out walking around in the rain with Duggee and notice a rainbow! But before they know it, it's gone and the Squirrels are devastated. They decide to make their own rainbow and go off in search of all the colours from everything around them, including strawberries, carrots and bananas. Duggee shows the Squirrels what he has been working on too - a rainbow cake!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Ambition Badge
programme.desc: Duggee masters his ambition of building a model of the Clubhouse out of sticks. This encourages the Squirrels to think of their own ambitions, and how they can achieve them.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Accessory Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels see Duggee accessorising his tie and want to learn how to do it themselves. All of the Squirrels accessorise an item and showcase their goods.

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - The Stokkur Geyser, Iceland
programme.desc: The Go Jetters are off to see the Geysers in Iceland, but Grandmaster Glitch and the Grimbots have beaten them to it, and managed to get themselves stuck in the Geysers.

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - Big Ben, England
programme.desc: The Go Jetters are on a mission to get Big Ben back to the Elizabeth Tower in time for it to chime at midnight! To the Vroomster!

programme.title: Thomas &amp; Friends S23 - All Tracks Lead to Rome
programme.desc: Thomas is working on the Italian Railway, keen to prove to his new friend Gina that he is an expert in all things Italian.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Band
programme.desc: Fifi, Little Woo and Fred call up Stanley to ask him to film their new song. They go around the town trying to find the perfect place.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Wonder Vole
programme.desc: Benjamin can't find his favourite toy, Wonder Vole anywhere. Stanley suggests they retrace his steps but have no luck. Maybe Wonder Vole Pyjamas will help Benjamin feel brave.

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals S01 - I Just Like Worms
programme.desc: From snails called David to Daddy Spider Longlegs', the funny animals talk about all things creepy and crawly.

programme.desc: When JoJo and Gran Gran pick up JoJo's cousin Lexi from school, JoJo wants to learn everything about what Lexi has been doing there. It's time for a Gran Gran plan - why don't they play schools when they get home? The cousins turn Gran Gran's living room into a classroom ready for Lexi to become a teacher. Writing, science, reading, counting, drawing and music - there's lots to learn! Then it's JoJo's turn to play teacher, but what can she teach? After all, she's never been to school. Gran Gran

programme.desc: Bingo and Lila are excited to play on their new waterslide.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Cricket
programme.desc: During a friendly game of neighbourhood cricket, the dads struggle to bowl Rusty out.

programme.desc: Worm and Ladybird wonder what's going on at Squirrel Club. There's a gorilla playing drums, some helpful ducks, a hot frog, four goats and a hospital run by chicken doctors.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Cool, Man
programme.desc: At Squirrel Club, Detective Puppy solves the mystery of a missing biscuit, the Rabbits tell us what's cool, and the Squirrels help Delivery Chipmunk with a huge parcel.

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Valley Of The Balls, Kazakhstan
programme.desc: The Go Jetters travel to the Valley of Balls in Kazakhstan, where they find thousands of rocks which are almost perfectly round. programme.title: Bluey S01 - Mums and Dads
programme.desc: When Indy and Rusty play Mums and Dads, they can't agree on who should go to work, so they part company. Indy has a hard time finding a babysitter, while Bluey makes Rusty her baby.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Handstand
programme.desc: At a party, Bingo is desperate to show off her handstand skills, while Nanna can't find a way to make herself useful. They're both feeling a bit lost, until they find each other.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Phones
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want to play restaurants with Grandad, but it's a little different than he's used to... he's going to need an app to order the food!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Pavlova
programme.desc: Mum won't let Bingo have Pavlova, so the kids find a way by playing a cheeky game of Café in the kitchen. But Dad the chef sets up a competing shop that only serves edamame beans.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island S01 - Andy and the Dino Tree Mystery
programme.desc: Andy meets a herd of Pachycephalosaurus and watches two males headbutting each other in a show of dominance.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Jelly
programme.desc: It's party time in Playtime Towers, and Bella and Lift enjoy a wibbly-wobbly jelly treat. Over in Boxtropolis, this gives Sketch an idea to paint a jellyfish.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Dream Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are at the Clubhouse playing, but they can't stop thinking about the dreams they had last night. Luckily, Duggee has his dream badge and can help the Squirrels work out what they mean. As the Squirrels think about dreams, all the different dreams of the Clubhouse friends become weirder and more wonderful. We even get to see Duggee's dream!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Rainbow Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are out walking around in the rain with Duggee and notice a rainbow! But before they know it, it's gone and the Squirrels are devastated. They decide to make their own rainbow and go off in search of all the colours from everything around them, including strawberries, carrots and bananas. Duggee shows the Squirrels what he has been working on too - a rainbow cake!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Ambition Badge
programme.desc: Duggee masters his ambition of building a model of the Clubhouse out of sticks. This encourages the Squirrels to think of their own ambitions, and how they can achieve them.

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - The Aqueduct of Segovia
programme.desc: Grandmaster Glitch has turned the Segovia Aqueduct into a giant water slide, by removing some of it's ancient stones to make it slope. But taking some of the perfectly balanced stones away means that the tall columns of the aqueduct are wobbling, and could come crashing down! The Go Jetters don't have long to stop Glitch and re-build the historic structure - Go Jetters, Go!

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - The Stokkur Geyser, Iceland
programme.desc: The Go Jetters are off to see the Geysers in Iceland, but Grandmaster Glitch and the Grimbots have beaten them to it, and managed to get themselves stuck in the Geysers.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S23 - Mines of Mystery
programme.desc: Amidst Italy's ancient sites and hidden treasures, Thomas is inspired to make his own special discovery and goes on a journey to find a lost legend.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Museum
programme.desc: Stanley and the children tour the museum and quickly realise there's nothing about them or their friends, so they make a new exhibit all about their town today!

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Band
programme.desc: Fifi, Little Woo and Fred call up Stanley to ask him to film their new song. They go around the town trying to find the perfect place.

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals S01 - I Could Be The Best Dancer In The Whole Entire World
programme.desc: From disco dancing frogs to skipping puffins and lions that love ballet, the talking animals discuss the best things about dancing.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran S03 - It's Time to Look for Signs
programme.desc: On the way home from Jared's shop with Gran Gran, JoJo finds out about the signs around them and what they mean. They are everywhere, and they all have a job to do. When they get home, Gran Gran has a plan to help JoJo make some signs of her own - there are even some special ones that they can share with Jared.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Slide
programme.desc: Bingo and Lila are excited to play on their new waterslide.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Cricket
programme.desc: During a friendly game of neighbourhood cricket, the dads struggle to bowl Rusty out.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Ghostbasket - Bluey special trilogy episode 1
programme.desc: Dad is pretending to be an estate agent selling the Grannies' house to Mum, but Janet and Rita do not want to move out. They try to disrupt the sale by ambushing Mum in the hallway, driving their car through the kitchen and introducing Ghostbasket - a ghastly haunted washing basket.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Talent Badge
programme.desc: Out for a walk, the Squirrels spot an interesting poster - it's King Tiger advertising his Roar Talent Show. Naturally, the Squirrels are very keen to take part. First, they need to find their talents. After they spend some time searching, Narrator explains that 'finding their talents' means working out what they are good at. So, the Squirrels practise their skills until they are ready to face an audience.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Transport Badge
programme.desc: When Duggee's old friend Rhodri goes home after a visit, he forgets his favourite hat. No worries, the Squirrels can run after him and give it back. They take all sorts of transport to catch Rhodri, and he is always one step ahead. Until finally, they're on a raft across the sea and land right by Rhodri's front door.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Mystery Seeds
programme.desc: When Duggee finds some seeds it's time for some gardening!

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Seattle Space Needle, USA
programme.desc: Glitch has attached huge rocket boosters to Grim HQ in an attempt to become the first Grandmaster in space. As he thunders up into the night sky, it looks like he may actually do it this time. Then the boosters splutter to a stop and he crashes back to Earth. Glitch clambers to his feet amongst the wreckage of Grim HQ and demands the Grimbots find him another spaceship. Meanwhile, the Go Jetters arrive at the Seattle Space Needle, a huge spire with a futuristic viewing platform made to look like

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Peas
programme.desc: Two peas perform a happy song.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Lemon
programme.desc: Lemon performs a stand-up routine!

programme.title: Supertato S02 - Merry Sprouty Day Part 1
programme.desc: It's Merry Sprouty Day, and everyone is waiting for Sprouty Claus, who is bringing presents to all the good fruit and veggies. However, Evil Pea has an evil plan - to steal the presents for herself!

programme.title: Supertato S02 - Merry Sprouty Day Part 2
programme.desc: It's Merry Sprouty Day, but Evil Pea jumps onto Sprouty Claus's train and steals all the presents for herself!

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Tickly
programme.desc: The Teletubbies enjoy doing 'Round and Round the Garden', especially the end of the rhyme where they all tickle each other. The Tiddlytubbies have tickly fun too.

programme.title: Yakka Dee S01 - Apple
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say apple and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see lots of different apples and explore how they look and taste. We see a green apple, a red apple, a shiny apple and a smiling, bobbing apple! Dee tries a yummy apple in an Autumn scene, flies a flying apple and cheers up a crying apple. The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way and everyone has a boogie when Dee's friend finally succeeds in saying today's word!

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO S02 - Journey to Socktropolis
programme.desc: Zam tries out her new navigator, which takes the friends to Socktropolis. But when the batteries run out, how will they get back?

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Super Secret Swoptops
programme.desc: It's secret agent time when Mojo and Bo think Didi the tractor is up to something fishy. But can the two supersecret spies follow her without being spotted?

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Omelette
programme.desc: Bingo is helping Mum make an omelette for Dad's birthday breakfast, but cracking eggs is harder than it looks, and Dad is getting hungrier by the minute.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Promises
programme.desc: Bluey keeps breaking her promises! But after seeing how much Bingo trusts Mum's word, Bluey learns the power of promises and why it's important not to break them.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Waiting Badge
programme.desc: When they're accidentally shut in the shed, Duggee shows the Squirrels how to make the time pass with calm breathing and made-up games. The Squirrels cope so well. Does Duggee?

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Tickly
programme.desc: The Teletubbies enjoy doing 'Round and Round the Garden', especially the end of the rhyme where they all tickle each other. The Tiddlytubbies have tickly fun too.

programme.title: Ambitious Kung Fu Girl
programme.desc: Si Si, a spoiled and naive rich girl with only basic kung fu training, becomes enchanted by the legends of the fearless hero Qin Ge. Determined to escape her father's arranged marriage, she disguises herself as a man and sets out to find him, hoping to challenge Qin Ge-only to be drawn into a deadly plot within the criminal underworld.

programme.title: Song Of Orchid Island
programme.desc: Dr. He moves to the remote Lanyu island off the coast of Taiwan to look for his long lost father, and starts to run a clinic curing islanders who are bitten by the fatal red worms there. He meets Ya Lan who works as a nurse in his clinic and falls in love with him. Things get vicious for Dr. He as a jealous islander plots to get rid of him...

programme.title: One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: Accepted to the Golden Sword School after his father sacrificed his life to save his master, Fang Kang is resented by his fellow pupils and decides to leave. His master's daughter challenges him to a fight and cuts off his arm. Fang masters the art of sword fighting with one arm and finds himself returning to the School to save his master again.

programme.title: Lovers Blades
programme.desc: The Lovers Blades, a pair of invincible weapons, are to be delivered to the Qing Emperor. However, they accidentally fell into the hands of Xiao Zhong Hui and Yuan Guan Nan, so Imperial Chief Zhuo Tian Xiong hunts them down for the blades. As the battle begins, the secret of the blades are also revealed.

programme.title: Pursuit
programme.desc: This movie tells the tale of Lin Chong, the Sung Dynasty's Chief Army Instructor who is framed by a corrupt official and has to embark on an exile fraught with danger. Helped by a monk, Lin Chong is finally able to take revenge.

programme.title: Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre 2
programme.desc: Only by bringing together the powerful Heaven Sword and the mighty Dragon Sabre can six martial arts sects struggling for supremacy be saved in this thrilling sequel to Chu Yuan's original hit.

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Zhang and Jin's daughter, Peony, are betrothed at birth but Jin objects to the engagement now. Zhang meets a carp spirit that looks exactly like Peony and they fall in love. When Justice Bao is asked by Jin to distinguish Peony from her replica, he decides to quit the case when he witness the true love between Zhang and the carp spirit.

programme.title: Legendary Weapons of China
programme.desc: Lei Kung, the leader of the Boxer Clan in Yunnan, dissolves the clan to save his disciples before going into self-exile. The Clan sends various assassins to kill him but failed. They then assigned Kung's brother Yong to find and kill Kung, leading to a battle between the two brothers.

programme.title: The Twin Swords
programme.desc: Gui Wu and his wife Gan Lian Zhu are the famous “Twin Swords” in the martial arts world. One day, they stumble upon a kidnapping plot at the Red Lotus Temple and Lian Zhu is held captive. Wu successfully escapes to find the Gan family for help, not knowing that he is sending them into an ambush by the kidnappers. Can he finally save Lian Zhu?

programme.title: Operation Lipstick
programme.desc: A professor's assistant stole a micro-film storing the secret of a newly invented nuclear reactor and sells it to a crime syndicate. However, the micro-film accidentally falls into the hands of a nightclub dancer and a thief in the process, leading to them being relentlessly pursued by the crime syndicate to retrieve the micro-film.

programme.title: Asia-pol
programme.desc: Asiapol agent Yang Ming Xuan trails a shipment of contraband gold being delivered to gang leader, George Eaton. He enlists the help of a Chinese woman who is trying to avenge her sister and narrowly escapes several deadly traps as he closes in on Eaton's location. This spy film is loosely inspired by the James Bond movies.

programme.title: Lion VS Lion
programme.desc: The traditional lion dance has never looked so good as in Lion VS Lion which captures the most impressive sequences of lion dancing on film. Besides being loaded with enjoyable martial arts chicanery, film historians can revel because it's also the first film that clearly demonstrates the intricacies and differences between the traditional Northern and Southern lion dancing techniques. The Five Venom alumnus and Chang Cheh discovery, Lo Meng, teams up with Liu Chia-liang protege Wang Yu, as they

programme.title: Forever And Ever
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po plays a young scholar who is manipulated into marrying a nobleman's reluctant daughter. After marrying, he soon discovers the reason for her hesitation. She is stricken with a contagious disease. But, with the power of true love, their romance prevails.

programme.title: Executioners From Shaolin
programme.desc: The White-Browed Priest supports the brutal Qing government, burning down Shaolin Temple and hunting its disciples. Shaolin's Hung falls in love with Fang while escaping the hunt and the couple have a son before Hung is killed by the Priest. To avenge his father, Hung's son creates a new form of martial art combining his parents' kung fu styles.

programme.title: The Happiest Moment
programme.desc: This erotic comedy anthology features three stories about an old man who dies from an overdose of virility pills, a cop who goes on the run after extorting money from a hooker, and a barber's apprentice who encounters a lively corpse in a night vigil. Through playing all these characters, Michael Hui proves himself as a genius of Hong Kong comedy.

programme.title: The Happiest Moment
programme.desc: This erotic comedy anthology features three stories about an old man who dies from an overdose of virility pills, a cop who goes on the run after extorting money from a hooker, and a barber's apprentice who encounters a lively corpse in a night vigil. Through playing all these characters, Michael Hui proves himself as a genius of Hong Kong comedy.

programme.title: Lady Of The Law
programme.desc: Chan, the chief of Wan Sheng Escort, is forced to raise his opponent's son, Yim. While Chan forbids Yim to practice martial arts, Yim secretly learns it. Ten years later, a rapist appears and Yim is arrested by a lady constable as the suspect. The rapist turns out to be Chan's elder son and Yim is framed by the Chans. Can Yim prove his innocence?

programme.title: Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: Yun Fei Yang, a Wudang servant hiding his identity as the sect leader's illegitimate son, is framed by long-hidden enemies and branded a traitor after losing his father. Hunted by rival forces and stripped of his martial arts, he masters the legendary “Tian Chan Gong” and rises again to clear his name and settle a generations-old blood feud.

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?
programme.desc: Jenny Hu, Shaw Brothers' gorgeous Chinese-German star, was given her first comedy role in the wild and wacky Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers? Described as "a comedy of belly laughs and chilling murders", it is a unique entry in the Hong Kong theater of the absurd.

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s “a-go-go” era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: The roguish scamp Zhen and his best friend Chia collects proof of corruption from the officials in this comedy-drama. After a string of blackmailing, they end up in positions of power, but what is to happen next?

programme.title: Golden Swallow
programme.desc: A heroine finds herself in a love triangle with a swordsman and a warrior. They team up to conquer the evil forces of the martial arts world but she is unable to choose between both men even as they face a deadly duel.

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: Seventh Sister, a curious fairy from heaven, descends to 1970s Hong Kong. Lost in an unfamiliar world, she is rescued by Tung Chi Lap, who runs a debt-ridden orphanage. When a tycoon plots to seize the land, she uses her powers to protect it, and an unlikely romance begins.

programme.title: Angel with the Iron Fists
programme.desc: Lo Wei directs and stars as the chief detective in this gripping thriller; playing alongside Lily Ho, who excels in the role of an undercover avenger that can fight as well as she flirts! Caught between the crime bosses known as Baldhead and Black Widow, she only has four choices: punch, kick, shoot or bombard with explosives!

programme.title: The Big Sting
programme.desc: Three buddies find a rare artifact known as the Double-Faced God but are poisoned by Lady Wu who steals the treasure from them. Before they die, they get their wives to promise to train their children to take back what is rightfully theirs. These kids grow up to exact a vengeance that turns out to be more hilarious than horrific in this comedy.

programme.title: The Hidden Power Of Dragon Sabre
programme.desc: Defeated villain Sung Ching Shu returns and starts a reign of terror, trapping a beautiful Mongolian Princess and mastering the "yin and yang combination" to become almost invincible. Only two swords held by two great swordsmen can stand in his way!

programme.title: The Grand Substitution
programme.desc: In this Opera epic, a loyal Imperial Court servant gives up his own newborn son to save the prince from an evil official.

programme.title: The Golden Lion
programme.desc: The Golden Lion is a bandit with good martial arts skills and often robs from the rich to help the poor. He is ambushed and attacked by a gang one night but luckily finds help from a master healer, who has to find a way to treat him while they are both being chased by the gang.

programme.title: Les Belles
programme.desc: Acknowledged as one of the greatest Hong Kong musicals, this lavish movie starring Linda Lin, who won Best Actress for her performance, infuses its wispy plot with style and wit, and the results are pure pleasure.

programme.title: Heroes of the East
programme.desc: A Chinese man marries a Japanese woman through an arranged marriage and manages to insult all of her Japanese martial arts family by issuing a challenge to her that is misinterpreted by the others. He must then prove how good Chinese Kung Fu really is through a series of duels with the seven Japanese martial artists who come to meet the challenge!

programme.title: Heroes of the East
programme.desc: A Chinese man marries a Japanese woman through an arranged marriage and manages to insult all of her Japanese martial arts family by issuing a challenge to her that is misinterpreted by the others. He must then prove how good Chinese Kung Fu really is through a series of duels with the seven Japanese martial artists who come to meet the challenge!

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping (Irene Chen I-ling) and Pai-hung (Betty Ting Pei) and ends when they are cast in a new movie.

programme.title: Shaolin Mantis
programme.desc: The Emperor orders Feng to find proofs of Master Tian's rebellion in his house. Feng falls in love with Tian's granddaughter and marries her. When he finds the proofs and tries to leave with her, his wife is killed in the fight against Tian. Feng creates the mantis-style martial arts and vows to avenge her death.

programme.title: Ode to Gallantry
programme.desc: In this surprisingly light-hearted "Venoms" martial arts adventure, a lone wanderer is repeatedly mistaken for someone else and drawn into a number of violent battles.

programme.title: The Bride from Hell
programme.desc: Fang Ming marries the mysterious young lady Leng Qiu Ping, only to discover she is a spirit forced to drain men's life essence. With a Taoist's help, he frees her from an evil force, but their love cannot cross life and death, and they part at dawn in a bittersweet farewell.

programme.title: Torrent Of Desire
programme.desc: Rich playboy David is a drunk until he falls in love with a fashion model Dan Feng and marries her. David's sister Mona is in love with his best friend Han Ming, who rejected her as he secretly loves Dan Feng as well. Out of jealousy and hatred, Mona lies to David about a fake affair between Han Ming and Dan Feng...

programme.title: Perils Of The Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: Chu Liuxiang and the Eighth Prince stage a fake assassination attempt, allowing Chu to infiltrate Ghostly Manor as an undercover agent and eradicate this den of evil. The manor harbours notorious martial arts criminals and is rumoured to be haunted. Soon, during his investigation, Chu becomes entangled in a series of mysterious and eerie events.

programme.title: The Pearl Phoenix
programme.desc: In Huangmei Opera tradition, this movie tells the love story of Wen, who sells himself as a slave to a rich family, and Huo, the family's young daughter. The lovers are kept apart by Huo's stepmother and Huo escapes by dressing up as a man. Wen is framed and put into jail so Huo has to go back and rescue her lover!

programme.title: The Weird Man
programme.desc: During the Three Kingdoms period, a Taoist priest Yu Ji cures many patients with his supernatural powers and is loved by the people. However, the arrogant general Sun Che thinks that Yu Ji bewitches people and orders for him to be beheaded. Subsequently, the spirit of the Yu Ji rises from his dead body and takes revenge on Sun Che.

programme.title: The Lark
programme.desc: Sixties pop star Carrie Ku plays the "Little Lark" in this romantic-drama of mistaken identity that is a treasure trove of some of the most popular Mandarin songs of all time.

programme.title: Gang Master
programme.desc: This is a story about an army out to destroy the Hsien Lung gang of anti-Yuan revolutionaries. Their leader Ru Yi Tu is up against Fu Zhong Yuan, the identified successor of the Hsien Lung gang who must also prove his own legitimacy. The plot thickens with murder, sibling rivalry and shocking discoveries that could change the course of history.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombie and Chan are martial arts experts!

programme.title: The 82 Tenants
programme.desc: Continuing the success of the classic comedy “House of 72 tenants”, this sequel tells the stories of tenants living in an old building in Hong Kong who are forced to evict by the developers. Some tenants prefer to take the compensation while some resist the move. Will the acquisitions plan destroy the harmony of the neighborhood?

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: This film is an amusing insider's look at the Hong Kong film industry and is based on Director Li Han Hsiang's popular newspaper column recounting his work at Shaw Brothers. The collection of some of his funniest and most surreal film musings of the era, filled with behind-the-scene asides, this is a must-see for any Hong Kong cinema aficionado!

programme.title: Men From The Gutter
programme.desc: Two very different cops are out to capture a local drug boss. In this sizzling crime thriller, the two cops go about doing their jobs differently - one does everything to the letter of the law and the other just doing whatever it takes to solve crime.

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: An imperial minister Cheng betroths his pretty younger daughter, Ye, to his friend's son, Mu. His wife however, refuses to let Ye marry before her elder daughter Yan, who is ugly and undesirable. Yan is asked to pretend as Ye to meet Mu but scares him away. A rich guy who likes Ye meanwhile pretends as Mu to attend the wedding...
